newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil barge diffs ease, cargoes stronger.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil barge diffs ease, cargoes stronger.

text.p: NWE gas oil barge premiums eased on Friday in a thinly-talked market but demand for heating oil cargoes was seen strong, said traders.
IPE Nov gas oil futures closed $1 up at $219.75 a tonne. The Nov/Dec spread shed 25 cents but still ended at a wide +$9.
The steep backwardation ahead of the Nov IPE contract expiry on Tuesday kept most barge buyers out of the market with sellers insisting on talking Nov-related numbers.
Heating oil barges were offered at Nov screen flat but bids had all but disappeared by late in the day.
Diesel barges fared worse, with offers slipping to Nov IPE +$10.50.
But good demand for heating oil cargoes was seen into Germany, with bids climbing to Dec IPE +$8 a tonne cif Hamburg.
An EU spec diesel cargo traded into Germany at Dec IPE +$17 cif Rostock, a slightly firmer premium than its last trade, but still depressed compared with mid-Oct levels.
Demand was also seen into France for diesel cargoes at Dec IPE +$15 cif Le Havre.
